manifest.notes: Sepolia only. LaunchToken deploys before ArbiterEscrow, whose sole constructor argument binds its immutable working currency to $token. The application requires no owner, initialization calls or token balance at deployment. Users acquire ARBT through the native ETH launch pool, approve escrow deposits and withdraw credited ARBT themselves. The pool has no hook. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96; services derive the effective opening price from the pinned policy when it specifies initialMarketCapWei. Policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
